item.title: Love, history and harmony: Valentine's Day then and now
item.description: From ancient festivals to medieval poetry and modern customs, Valentine’s Day has continually adapted to cultural shifts.

item.title: Maccelli scores two, Toronto Maple Leafs dump Edmonton Oilers 5-2
item.description: EDMONTON — Matias Maccelli scored twice and the Toronto Maple Leafs downed the Edmonton Oilers 5-2 on Tuesday.

item.title: West Van landscape architect defined Vancouver's urban environment
item.description: Don Vaughan worked on several high-profile projects, including the plazas of Granville Island, the public spaces of Expo 86 and the development of False Creek.

item.title: Son of late dictator Gadhafi is killed in Libya
item.description: CAIRO (AP) — Seif al-Islam Gadhafi, the son and one-time heir apparent of Libya's late dictator Moammar Gadhafi, was killed in the northern African country, Libyan officials said Tuesday.

item.title: NHL roundup: Olivier's two goals and Merzlikins' shutout power Blue Jackets to sixth straight win
item.description: NEWARK, N.J. (AP) — Mathieu Olivier scored twice in the third period, and Elvis Merzlikins made 23 saves for his first shutout of the season as the Columbus Blue Jackets beat the New Jersey Devils 3-0 on Tuesday night for their sixth straight win.
